name: Abdeel
overview: Abdeel is a male figure mentioned uniquely in Rahlfs' Septuaginta version of Genesis 25:3 as the son of Dedan. His name does not appear in the traditional BHS Hebrew text, marking a notable textual variant. No tribe or surname is attributed to him in the biblical record.
namesAndTitles: The name Abdeel appears only once in the Septuagint text of Genesis 25:3 without a provided meaning or divine origin. It is presented simply as a proper name without further etymological or theological significance noted.
familyAndRelationships: Scripture does not record any family relationships for Abdeel beyond his identification as the son of Dedan. No additional relatives or connections are documented.
scriptureSignificance: Abdeel's significance lies primarily in his mention as part of the genealogical record in Genesis 25:3 within the Septuagint tradition. This inclusion highlights the textual variations present in biblical manuscripts and underscores the importance of careful study of different textual witnesses. Although little is known about his life or role, his presence contributes to the broader understanding of the descendants of Dedan.
